question: How are the upper and lower shells of the cosmic egg described?
premises: The upper shell is sattva touched by a trace of darkness.
The lower shell is sattva touched by passion.
The lower aspect is also associated with darkness.
inference: Thus the two shells of the egg are differentiated by mixtures of the three qualities.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of nirmṛṣṭaṃ sattvam to the lower shell is compressed.
plain_english: The upper shell of the egg is purity touched by a trace of darkness, while the lower shell is purity touched by passion and associated with darkness.
